notes.title: Update 1.9 - Custom Background Colors
notes.notes:
[h1]Custom Background Color[/h1]

-Added a custom background color option. The color can be set by selecting the color from the chart. The setup should allow for any color you want.

[h1]New Rectangular Puzzles[/h1]

-Added in new puzzles unique for the 28x20 puzzle size. The puzzles are optimized for the rectangular shape of the 28x20 puzzle.

[h1] Option Menu Redesigned [/h1]

- The option menu was updated and cleaned up.

- Text was added to explain each game mode when selected.

- A sample image was added to preview the selected puzzle size.

[h1] Custom Puzzles [/h1]

- The default custom image was updated. 

- Wording in the custom image instruction file was updated to no longer state a specific resolution is required on the custom image

[h1] New Default Backgrounds [/h1]

- The default background options have changed.

[h1] Scroll Mode - Keyboard [/h1]

- The boxes in scroll mode now can be swapped using the left and right keyboard keys. (Previously only the right mouse button would increment it)

[h1] Puzzle Complete Screen Updated [/h1]

- The sparkles in the puzzle compete screen was updated to include a tiny jigsaw puzzle piece. 

- Sparkles altered to be unique on the Candy Corn puzzle (tab 10) and winter themed puzzles (starting on tab 11)

- The puzzle keeps displaying the jigsaw pieces at the end (instead of swapping to final clean image like before)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/98701c61c20999757f793ccdde85d5ea5546623c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.7 - Scroll Mode Updated, Zoom Feature, and Extended Save Options
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.7 Release Notes:[/h1]

[h1]Scroll mode changes: [/h1]
The concept is the same but now with a "box" to hold the pieces. Text added to state the current box out of the total boxes.

[h1]All puzzles save now:[/h1]
Expanded the puzzle saves to create a save per puzzle variation. Changing the piece count, piece size, or puzzle mode is a different puzzle variation. (Anything that triggered a new puzzle in the current game) 

[h1]Reset button:[/h1]
Added a reset button to reset a puzzle if you completed it and want to go again. Otherwise you will always load your previous puzzle.

[h1]Dynamic Piece Size:[/h1]
The middle mouse wheel will change the piece size dynamically. The puzzle will save the setting. There is no change to the small and large piece settings. These settings still start the puzzle in the "small" and "large" pieces however you can override them as you feel it is needed.

[h1]Digital Background:[/h1]
One new background was added in the digital theme.

[list]

Five new watercolor photos have been added as puzzles. 

[h1]New Backgrounds [/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/9ba7ad49dc79789e3f30d4e471e508b656e1a7b1.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/1836755cae1d7477f9164963047303ca9010fc03.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/96592712f87694a14e48457fce5100a22554a0f5.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/26e09836e8521bc162fca4146e9cfd816e94f370.jpg[/img][/url]

Three new backgrounds have been added in a watercolor theme.

[h1]Puzzle #150 - The custom puzzle![/h1]

The 150th puzzle is the most special puzzle. This puzzle allows you to load in a custom photo. This puzzle will always be listed last on the list. To add the custom photo follow the below steps. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/666d9733198112ca1457dfbf4a3a61faa71f90ec.png[/img]

Click the selection that states: "Click here to open folder containing custom photos". A standard window explorer will open automatically to the location of the custom puzzle photo. You would need to replace this photo with your own. 

Currently the custom photo must retain the below equirements. There is also a file in the folder repeating these requirements if you need a reminder.

Filename: custom.jpg
1024x1024 pixels
.jpg format

If you need help leave a message on the discussion forum. As this is a new feature if anything isn't functioning correclty leave a note on the forum as well and I'll look into it immediately. This feature will be developed more in the future.


[h1] Example Custom Puzzle [/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/eb6a6e021974dbb28ac573a8da0364bd4139c5fb.png[/img]

Steam Logo loaded as the custom puzzle.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - New arrangement mode called the Swimming Pool!
notes.notes:
[h1]Introducing the new arrangment mode called - Swimming Pool![/h1]

This arrangement mode is perfect for those of you needing a big clear area to start your puzzle. The pieces in this mode will float like in water on the left and right sides of the screen. The pieces will slowly rotate around to give you optimal view of all the pieces while maintaining a small area. This arrangement mode will be the third variation available in addition to the table and scroll modes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/e6566adb161d69ce3d2f97cf8204bb83f12154a8.png[/img]

This update will be free to Digital Jigsaw Puzzle. All puzzles, updates, and future contents are always free and are included in the base game.

Don't have the game? There is a special discount on the full game for one week!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
- Puzzles will now save after every time a piece is connected. The save will reload after closing the game as long as the same puzzle is selected. The save is cleared if another puzzle is selected or an option menu selection is changed.

- The option menu will now save between sessions. You will always start the game in the same mode, number of pieces, and same background color.

- Fixed issue with initial placement of puzzle pieces. The layout should be more elegant now.

- Added hot key for full screen mode (F11 Key). 

Known Bug:
The fullscreen mode may need to be activated twice in a row.
